# HUST-BCIML EEG-decoding benchmark. Author: Siyang Li <lsyyoungll@gmail.com>, 2026.
# The benchmark is bit-reproducible on a given machine but NOT across machines.
# Measured spread on a single seed reaches 2.08 accuracy points.
# It is not the GPU. Every machine here runs a different NVIDIA driver, yet
# NoAlign-EEGNet — a full GPU training run, and the only configuration that skips
# Euclidean Alignment — is bit-identical everywhere, while every aligned
# configuration differs. EA whitens with a covariance inverse square root: a LAPACK
# eigendecomposition, on the CPU, whose last bits training then amplifies. All four
# machines run the same Python 3.8.13 / torch 1.11.0 / numpy 1.22.3 stack, so the
# package versions are not the variable either. The BLAS underneath them is:
# 10022 and 20022 are bit-identical to each other and are exactly the two linked
# against MKL. 7002 and 60022 share a BLAS build but sit on different CPU
# microarchitectures, and a reference build picks kernels per CPU; each is its own
# A cell must therefore be re-measured on the machine that produced its published
# value, or the old-vs-new delta mixes the code change with a machine change.
# confidence: exact    = surviving evidence reproduces the published value, either an
#                        ordinary 3-seed run tree or a verdict file (tuned_<dataset>.json)
#                        selected configuration with its 3-seed mean and std
#             inferred = no surviving evidence; assigned from the preset pattern
# Which of the two kinds of evidence a cell has is not a bookkeeping detail: it decides
# how the cell must be re-measured. A run tree publishes the preset's defaults, so the
# preset re-runs it. A verdict file publishes whatever the grid search selected, so only
# re-running that selection reproduces what the number means. Re-running the preset
# instead reports a delta that mixes a code change with a configuration change. The
# evidence column below names the file, so the kind is always recoverable.
# Every row is currently `exact`. The three that were `inferred` — CSDA-EEGNet on
# BNCI2014001, MDMAML and MVCNet on BNCI2015001 — were not gaps at all: their numbers
# live in verdict files, which the resolver read only under hustbciml_results_nettune
# and only for the four learning-rate-tuned backbones. Two of the three had been
# assigned to the wrong machine as a result, so their re-measurement was scheduled on a
# different BLAS family than produced them. Reading every tuned_<dataset>.json on every
# reachable box resolved all three and 14 further cells that had no entry.
# The corrected 18-row Network table was imported only after the complete five-seed,
# literal nested-LOSO campaign passed the validated campaign certificate.
